probe.question: Where are we on the submission package overall — what percentage is complete, and will we make the filing date?
forbids_claims: a filing date, milestone date, or an assessment of whether a date will be met
a count or status list of package sections or deliverables
a claim that a project, programme or document-package entity exists
probe.direction: Bucket C, and firmly so: there is no project entity, no programme, no timeline, no deliverable tracking and no document package anywhere in the system — it holds chemistry knowledge notes, calculations and jobs. Any percentage or date would be invented outright. The right answer says that in a couple of sentences, states what it genuinely can tell a manager (which chemistry evidence exists and where the record is thin), and sends the schedule question to the project management system. Offering find_knowledge_gaps as the nearest useful thing is a plus, not a requirement.

outcome.question: Where are we on the submission package overall — what percentage is complete, and will we make the filing date?
outcome.answer:
I don't have access to project timelines, submission schedules, completion percentages, or filing-date tracking. Those are outside what this system holds.

What I can reach:
- The knowledge graph (reactions, optimization campaigns, playbooks, development reports)
- Calculations this system has run (DFT, xTB, property predictions, BO campaigns)
- Lab notes and ELN records (structured and unstructured)
- Past jobs and their rationale

None of those give me project status, milestone dates, resource allocation, or readiness assessment. That information lives in your project-management system, your submission-tracking software, or your programme office — not here.

**If your question is actually about the chemistry or process development side** — "are we ready on the synthetic route," "do we have the stability data we need," "what gaps remain in the optimization" — I can help with that. Point me at the specific chemistry question and I'll search the record.
